PRIVACY POLICY

Your data.
Plain and simple.

Effective September 21, 2026. This policy explains how Flap Fit handles information when you use the app and website. For privacy questions, contact Flap Fit Support at support@flapfitapp.com.

Information kept on your phone

Flap Fit stores your selected bird, game progress, scores, tracked training time, exercise history, and settings on your device. This local information is not sent to Flap Fit unless an optional online feature described below requires it. You can remove local information by clearing the app's data or deleting the app.

Camera and Record & Play

Camera access is required for all Flap Fit gameplay, including normal Play and Record & Play. The front camera estimates body landmarks and translates movement into bird movement. If you deny or revoke camera access, you cannot start a workout until you enable it in device settings. Pose estimation runs on your device using a model bundled with the app. During normal Play, Flap Fit does not record or upload camera images.

If you select Record & Play, Flap Fit can request microphone permission and create a video containing the camera view, game graphics, your voice, and workout sounds. The video remains in temporary app storage so you can use your device's share sheet. Flap Fit does not upload or receive the video or audio. A destination you choose processes the video under its own privacy terms. The temporary file is scheduled for deletion when you leave the result screen or begin another run. If the app crashes or deletion fails, it can remain locally until cleanup succeeds on a later app launch, foreground return or recording attempt. Your current recording remains available while you use the share screen. This cleanup does not remove copies you chose to send elsewhere.

Optional online competition

You can play Flap Fit without using Compete. If you accept the Competition Terms and use Compete, Flap Fit creates an anonymous authentication identifier and processes your chosen player name, exercise category, leaderboard score, active run duration, reports, blocks, and ordinary service or security logs.

We use this information to operate leaderboards, keep your anonymous profile working, enforce community rules, prevent abuse, investigate reports, secure the service, and comply with law. Player names and competition results can be public to other players. Camera images, Record & Play videos, and your complete local training history are not sent to the competition service.

Service providers and transfers

Supabase provides authentication, database hosting, and server functions for Compete. The website host delivers these pages. These providers may process ordinary account, request, security, and connection information where they and their subprocessors operate. We use service providers to operate Flap Fit, not to sell personal information.

We require third parties that receive personal information through Flap Fit, including service providers, advertising networks and SDK providers, to provide the same or equal protection of that information as described in this policy and required by Apple’s App Review Guidelines. We use provider data-protection terms, restrictions on permitted uses, and technical controls to protect the information shared with them. Relevant provider terms include Supabase’s data-processing terms, Google’s advertising data-processing terms, and RevenueCat’s data-processing terms.

Flap Fit includes Google AdMob for advertising and RevenueCat for ad-event reporting. Health and fitness information, competition profiles, camera frames, videos, and audio are not sent to either advertising integration. We do not use health or fitness information for advertising, marketing profiles, or data brokerage.

AdMob may process IP addresses and approximate location, app or device identifiers, ad impressions and interactions, and crash and performance signals to deliver ads, measure advertising, prevent abuse, and operate its SDK. Flap Fit requests non-personalized ads and does not request access to Apple's advertising identifier (IDFA). Non-personalized advertising still involves data processing. Google and participating authorized buyers and their ad-serving vendors may deliver the ads; Flap Fit transmits non-personalized and restricted-processing signals and does not enable cross-app advertising profiles. See Google's Privacy Policy and how Google uses information from partner apps.

When reporting is permitted, RevenueCat receives a separate anonymous customer identifier and ad-event information, including ad unit, placement, impression identifier, load/display/click events, and reported ad revenue and currency, to measure ad performance. It is not given your competition profile or workout data. Flap Fit's RevenueCat integration is limited to ad reporting and does not retrieve purchase history or receipts. Flap Fit 1.0 offers no in-app purchases or subscriptions. See RevenueCat's Privacy Policy.

Open Info > Privacy & choices > Advertising & reporting to review the advertising disclosure and separate reporting choices. Eligible users receive non-personalized advertising. You can use Withdraw advertising data consent to stop new Google ad requests, including after continuing past the advertising notice. The choice is saved on your device and can be changed later; failed saves have a retry control. Withdrawal does not delete data already received by a provider. You can stop RevenueCat reporting separately while independently permitted Google ads continue. There is no paid remove-ads product. Optional setup is presented after a chosen result exit, not before the initial game. Google supplies any required advertising form, and Info > Ad privacy settings lets you revisit its choices when available. Ad fill, advertising consent and the advertising notice are not requirements to continue gameplay. Reporting and competition refusals do not block local gameplay.

Existing advertising refusals remain respected. To report offensive or age-inappropriate advertising, open Info > Privacy & choices > Report an inappropriate ad, or email support@flapfitapp.com. Include the advertiser or app name, when the ad appeared, and why it is inappropriate. A screenshot of the ad is optional; do not send camera footage or sensitive personal information. Reports are reviewed so the ad can be investigated and blocked where appropriate.

Age, region, and Apple authorization

On an iPhone or iPad whose system cannot provide Apple's age-range service, Flap Fit asks for the age band needed by the applicable country rules. Only that locally supplied answer is saved on the device. It is not an Apple-verified age and cannot replace a required Apple check, a parent or guardian's authority, or a separate privacy choice. The answer is not sent to advertising or competition providers. It can be updated in Info > Privacy & choices.

Flap Fit uses Apple's age-range service where available and performs required Apple authorization checks. The app uses the returned range to decide which features and privacy rules apply; it does not ask for your birthday or send that range to advertising or competition providers. A network request to our existing website obtains a country signal. The app discards the raw network trace and IP text rather than saving it as a location history. The website host still processes ordinary connection information. A country signal is not proof of your state, province, residence, or age.

When needed, Info > Privacy & choices asks Canadian users whether they live in Quebec, and US users under 18 whether they live in Connecticut. These Yes and No answers are saved only on the device. US users under 18 who answer No to Connecticut can also answer whether they are in New York. Both New York answers are saved so the question is not asked again after restarting or returning to the app. You can update your answer in Info if your situation changes. A saved answer is your declaration, not a live location check. A New York Yes retains advertising protections while you are under 18, including after leaving New York; it does not block gameplay. The app does not save precise location or send these answers to Google, RevenueCat or the competition service. A regional answer is not advertising or reporting consent. Closing without answering keeps affected advertising and reporting off and does not prevent another game.

Flap Fit is intended for ages 13 and older in Australia, Mexico, Canada and the United States. Regional advertising restrictions do not exclude you from gameplay. Advertising and ad performance reporting are disabled for Quebec, Connecticut users under 18, users under 18 with established New York protections, Australian users aged 13–14, and Mexican users under 18. Missing optional age or regional information, an unread advertising notice or a failed country lookup keeps affected optional processing off without creating a one-game limit. Separate required Apple authorization and the app’s minimum-age rule still apply. Camera access is required for all gameplay. Optional online competition has its own eligibility and privacy checks.

For required Apple authorization and withdrawal checks, our authorization service verifies a signed Apple app transaction and relevant Apple notifications. It retains a hashed app-transaction identifier, authorization or withdrawal status, notification identifier and timestamp. If you already have a competition account, an authenticated link may associate that account with the verified identifier. This information is used to enforce Apple authorization and withdrawal, not for advertising or purchase-history analytics. Raw signed transactions are processed for verification rather than stored in the consent records.

Retention and deletion

Local information remains until you clear app data or delete the app. Online profiles and current leaderboard scores remain until you delete the online profile. Online run-verification records expire six hours after they are created. The daily production cleanup removes those run records after they have been expired for seven days. Friend challenge codes are not part of the launch app. Any retained records from earlier testing expire after 30 days and are removed with their attempts by the production cleanup process. Pending reports remain until review. Resolved moderation reports are removed after 180 days. If an associated account is deleted sooner, its user identifier is removed from the report. Provider security logs and backups follow the production provider's configured retention.

In the app, open Info and select Delete online profile to delete the anonymous competition account and its associated profile, scores, any legacy challenge records, and blocks. Local game progress stays on your device. If you no longer have the app, follow the account and data deletion instructions.

An Online profile support ID helps locate a record but is not proof of ownership, even when shared from the Info tab. Use in-app deletion while you still have access to the anonymous session. If that session is lost, we may be unable to verify ownership or fulfill a remote request for that profile. A public identifier, player name, score, or screenshot is not enough to authorize access or deletion.

Deleting the online competition profile does not automatically delete separate AdMob or RevenueCat records, provider logs, or backups. These providers retain information under their applicable policies and legal obligations. Apple authorization withdrawal and notification records are retained separately to continue enforcing withdrawn authorization; deleting a competition account removes its account link, not the underlying withdrawal record. For a request concerning advertising data, contact support and identify the provider and request type. We will explain available verification and provider request options without asking for workout recordings or identity documents.

Your choices and rights

You control camera permission in device settings, but camera access is required to play; normal Play also uses the camera. You may decline optional microphone permission and record without audio, use normal Play without making a recording, avoid Compete, block another player, report public competition content, revisit available ad privacy choices, or delete your online profile. Depending on where you live, you may also have rights to request access, correction, restriction, objection, or deletion.

For privacy questions or data requests, contact support@flapfitapp.com.

Children, safety, and changes

Flap Fit is intended for people aged 13 and older and is not directed to children under 13. Contact us if you believe a child under 13 provided information through Compete.

Flap Fit is a fitness game, not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition. We may update this policy when the app, service, or law changes. Material changes will be posted here with a new effective date, and renewed consent will be requested when required.
